description: Ministry of Justice and National Integration - Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act. No 02 of 2012 Notification under Subsection (5) of Section 7
categorisation: This gazette contains a notification about the extension of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically deals with parliamentary approval of a ministerial order extending the operation period of existing legislation, falling under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and legal amendments.
